title: IBM shares fall 12%+ after Anthropic outlined in a blog post how Claude Code can automate the exploration and analysis phases of COBOL modernization (Pia Singh/CNBC)
summary: Pia Singh / CNBC: IBM shares fall 12%+ after Anthropic outlined in a blog post how Claude Code can automate the exploration and analysis phases of COBOL modernization — International Business Machines stock is getting slammed, becoming the latest victim of rapidly developing AI technology, after Anthropic's Claude announced COBOL capabilities.
